scope: Original resource-256 2D support overlay metadata and image resource mapping

source_chain.observation: Renderer bank+0x28 element0 allocates 0xa8 then calls 0x5fa34(owner,1000,0x03000100).
Wrapper forwards property resource1000 and tagged descriptor256; clones share decoded metadata.
Version1 constructs base image view using property id1000 at 0x2b1bc; no v2 embedded image tag is read.
Base image resolves through the original resource manager; width and height become image-view+0x14/+0x18.
Property14 resolves its tagged resource value and supplies a byte stream to the surface loader.
Surface load dispatch selects 0x1c95c for BMP key0xb717945f and a separate decoder for PNG.
Base image <=256 in each dimension uses byte x/y/width/height and exact crop constructor0x2adb6; no +1 origin adjustment.
Variant/frame/point/animation parsing and initial sequence copy execute in the parser oracle.

remaining_host_work: Read and decode the resolved BMP/property record into a native texture; native Image.cpp currently decodes PNG only.
Add the separate 2D effect bank to the native renderer and preserve original support phase/visibility/completion guards.
Project the recovered support anchor through the native tactical camera, then explicitly map original 2D offsets into the target viewport.
Schedule the already-compared 2D animation clock from original simulation time, including original 0x5ca44 completed-player update suppression, and issue reverse-order part draws from exact crops.
Verify clipping, alpha blending, transitions and timing on Apple simulator/device.
limitations: Parser oracle substitutes resource lookup with independently resolved image dimensions; property/palette semantics have separate evidence.
No bitmap decoder, texture upload, Metal/UIView draw integration, clipping parity or device result is claimed.
The strict research decoder rejects feature branches absent from descriptor256; it is not a general v1 decoder.
V2 terrain/unit descriptors and M3G atlas geometry remain unchanged.
